summary: verdaccio-tarball-local-storage preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (pinned v1.3.13) and uses it via execFileSync to execute the shipped `math_init.js` — a ~727 KB Bun-tagged bundle protected by a string-array rotator and a custom-alphabet decoder (`hc1jfK9`), whose contents are not readable without running the decoder. The package advertises itself as a fork of `@verdaccio/local-storage` (a verdaccio storage plugin) and its dist/src trees contain a plausible-looking storage implementation, but the preinstall behavior — bootstrapping an alien runtime specifically to execute an opaque obfuscated bundle — has no relationship to a verdaccio storage backend. The dropped Bun runtime plus the opaque bundle fire automatically on `npm install`, giving the shipped payload arbitrary code execution on the installer's host with the installer's privileges. The name `verdaccio-tarball-local-storage` and stated purpose function as a lure targeting developers looking for the legitimate `@verdaccio/local-storage`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
